title: Wage Account Group Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
One line of a wage account group: which ledger account a wagetype posts to, its offset account and cost elements.

Not read at present: the cost engine and the journal voucher take their accounts from each employee's own wage accounts, and nothing reads these lines. They are kept for reference and for future use.

fields.label: WageAccGroupId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wage Acc Group master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The wage account group this line belongs to.

Example. Head Office Accounts

fields.label: WageTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wage Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The wagetype this line maps.

Example. Basic Salary

fields.label: AccountInfoId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Account Info master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The ledger account the wagetype would post to.

Example. 510100 — Salaries and Wages

fields.label: OffsetAccountInfoType
fields.rules: Required. One of: Fixed, Employee Code.
fields.html:
What it is. Where the balancing account comes from: a fixed account chosen below, or one worked out from the employee code.

Example. Fixed

fields.label: OffsetAccountInfoId
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Account Info master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The balancing account, when the offset type is Fixed.

Example. 210500 — Salaries Payable

fields.label: CostPercentage
fields.html:
What it is. The share of the wagetype's amount this line would carry.

Example. 100

fields.label: MergeOffsetAccount
fields.html: What it is. Whether offset lines for this mapping would be merged into one.

fields.label: CostElement1Id
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Cost Element master data.
fields.html: What it is. Cost element 1 — one of up to seven accounting dimensions. Captioned with the name of the cost element type whose code is CostElement1, and lists only cost elements of that type; not shown at all when no such type exists.
fields.adminHtml: The slot captions come from Organization Management → Cost Element Types: give a type the code CostElement1 to CostElement7 to switch that slot on. A saved value whose cost element has since moved to another type is still shown, by its number, so opening the row does not clear it.
